h1: GLOW Ao Nang Krabi — a value hotel in Ao Nang within walking distance of the beach and night market
intro: Not everyone who comes to Krabi is chasing a beachfront luxury resort — plenty of people just want a clean room, a light price and a location you can walk everywhere from, then spend the savings on island tours. GLOW Ao Nang Krabi plays exactly that role — a value 3-star hotel on Soi 8 in Ao Nang, about a 10-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach and close to the night market and restaurants. There are 160 modern rooms, including roomy family rooms that guests praise, an outdoor pool with a poolside bar and a kids club · from approx. ฿1,000/night (rising in high season).

body.html: GLOW Ao Nang Krabi is a mid-size, 160-room hotel from GLOW Hotels & Resorts, set on Soi 8, Moo 3 in Ao Nang. The point reviews agree on most is value for the location — it's about a 10-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach and close to Nopparat Thara Beach, the Ao Nang Landmark night market, restaurants, massage shops and convenience stores. For anyone who wants to use Krabi as a base for island tours and come back to sleep, this is the kind of spot where almost everything is within walking distance of your door.

Rooms come in several types, from a starter Standard King/Twin up through Superior, Deluxe and family rooms in Triple, Quad and Family Suite layouts. The most consistent praise goes to the family rooms — wide enough for groups or families with kids, with comfortable beds, and the well-kept ones are clean and tidy. But to be honest, room quality is inconsistent — several reviews report bathrooms with stains, rust or traces of mould, and some materials are starting to show their age. If you land a room that isn't up to scratch, ask to switch at check-in.
"The family room was bigger than expected and we could walk to the beach and night market easily. Great value for Ao Nang — but the bathrooms could be cleaner."

The common areas include an outdoor pool with a poolside bar that's a nice spot to wind down in the evening, plus a kids club that makes the hotel work for families. There are two gyms (cardio and weights) for anyone who wants to train. One thing several reviews flag is that the pool gets limited sun because of surrounding buildings — for part of the day it sits in shade, so if you're planning to sunbathe by the pool all day, it may not deliver.

Breakfast is a buffet with a live cooking station, charged at roughly THB 300–350 per person (not included in most room rates). Many guests find it worth paying for, but others simply eat out since restaurants are within walking distance. Staff service is a fairly consistent strong point in reviews — the team is friendly and helpful, especially at check-in and with arranging tours. There's a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge) and laundry service too.

One thing worth being clear about is the star rating. Booking.com lists GLOW as a 4-star, but nearly every other platform rates it 3-star — and plenty of reviews say outright that if you expect 4-star standards you may be disappointed. The room condition and upkeep are a good budget level, not premium. Set the expectation that this is a well-located, value 3-star hotel and the experience lands much better.

With 8.3 from 1,158 Trip.com reviews and 4.0/5 on TripAdvisor (ranked #59 of 202 hotels in Ao Nang), GLOW Ao Nang Krabi suits travellers who value a light price, a walkable location near the beach and market, and roomy family rooms more than luxury or brand-new bathrooms. The tip is to inspect your room right at check-in, book with free cancellation in case you need to switch, and not to expect all-day sun by the pool. On value and position, it genuinely delivers in this price bracket.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — GLOW Ao Nang Krabi

faq.q: Where is GLOW Ao Nang Krabi · can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: It's at 199/46 Soi 8, Moo 3 in Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi · about a 10-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach, near Nopparat Thara Beach (~5 min drive), the Ao Nang Landmark night market, restaurants and convenience stores · roughly 30 minutes by car from Krabi Airport (KBV) · a location you can explore Ao Nang from with barely any need for a car.

faq.q: How much does GLOW Ao Nang Krabi cost · what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿1,000/night for a Standard room · stepping up to Superior, Deluxe and family Triple/Quad rooms plus a Family Suite for groups and families · prices depend on dates and package, and climb quickly in high season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: How many stars is GLOW Ao Nang Krabi · what's the standard like?
faq.a: Booking.com lists it as 4-star, but nearly every other platform rates it 3-star · many reviews say the reality is a well-located, value 3-star hotel rather than premium · set your expectations to a good budget stay in a great spot and the experience lands better.

faq.q: Who is GLOW Ao Nang Krabi best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travellers who want an affordable Ao Nang base within walking distance of the beach and market, and families who need a roomy room · there's a kids club and a pool · it's less suited to those after a luxury beachfront resort, brand-new rooms, or all-day sun by the pool.

faq.q: Is breakfast included at GLOW Ao Nang?
faq.a: Breakfast is a buffet with a live cooking station, charged at roughly THB 300–350 per person and not included in most room rates · check at booking whether your package includes it · restaurants are within walking distance, so you can compare first.

faq.q: How far ahead should you book · is cancellation possible?
faq.a: In high season (November–April), book 3–6 weeks ahead, especially for family rooms which sell out fastest · most platforms offer a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't fixed, or in case you need to switch rooms at check-in.
